parameters.jsCode: const r=$json; const relation = r.supplier && r.asset; if(!relation) throw new Error('MISSING_RELATIONSHIP'); return [{json:{...r, evidence:[r.id,r.asset], requesting_agent:'relationship_agent'}}];

const r=$json; const shares={supplier_defect:[100,0],shared:[60,40],internal_change:[0,100]}; const [supplier_share,internal_share]=shares[r.root_cause]||[0,0]; return [{json:{...r,supplier_share,internal_share,decision_basis:r.root_cause==='shared'?'Supplier defect plus deferred internal mitigation':r.root_cause, requesting_agent:'attribution_agent'}}];

const r=$json; const hourly=6000; const work_cost=Math.round(r.work_minutes/60*hourly); return [{json:{...r,work_cost,calculation:`${r.work_minutes} minutes / 60 × INR ${hourly}`,calculation_engine:'deterministic-v1'}}];

parameters.text: =You are AfterPO's causal evidence critic. Review the operational record below. Do not calculate money and do not authorize any action. Return concise JSON with keys: attribution (supplier|shared|internal|inconclusive), confidence (0 to 1), competing_cause, evidence_ids, and rationale. Cite only evidence present in the input. If evidence conflicts or is missing, choose inconclusive. Input: {{ JSON.stringify($json) }}
